summary.intent: Run a compound engineering retrospective, dogfood CAS cognitive routing through Lemonade local inference, build a multimodal journey rendering pipeline, fix the vault MCP, and close the knowledge compound loop so session learnings automatically persist to vault and SurrealDB.
summary.outcome: CAS classifier wired into CompoundExecutor with Qwen3-8B on Vulkan GPU (350ms/classify, 21 tests passing), Lemonade MCP server built with 13 tools and registered via .mcp.json, journey rendering pipeline working end-to-end (physics→LLM narration→TTS→sonification→viz in ~13s), vault MCP fixed (FastMCP v1.26 breaking change), KnowledgeOracle built for cross-store search across vault/SurrealDB/KEY_LEARNINGS, and Stop hook registered to auto-persist session learnings.

repo: Two Lemonade instances run simultaneously: port 13306 (system, /usr/bin/lemond) handles GPU Vulkan + CPU models; port 13307 (vendor embedded, vendor/lemonade/) handles NPU FLM models only

System Lemonade config defaults to ROCm backend which is broken on gfx1151 (Strix Halo) — must run `sudo -u lemonade lemonade config set llamacpp.backend=vulkan` once to prevent stuck 100% CPU processes
Qwen3-8B-GGUF requires `/no_think` prefix in every prompt; without it the model spends all tokens in internal reasoning and returns empty string
gemma3-4b-FLM returns `<pad>` tokens for chat prompts — FLM (Fast Language Model) NPU-compiled variants are not instruction-tuned for chat, only for embeddings/vision

SurrealDB synapse source/target fields are stored as strings ('neurons:abc') not record links (neurons:abc), causing all relational queries to silently return 0 matches; use string-cast matching as workaround

sd-cpp Vulkan backend unavailable for this Lemonade version; sd-cpp (cpu/rocm) has a RPATH bug where libstable-diffusion.so is not found unless LD_LIBRARY_PATH is manually set — Lemonade packaging bug
`lemonade pull` via API only registers model metadata, does not download weights; actual download happens at first load or via `lemonade` CLI binary directly
Vault MCP (cloud-vault-mcp) broken: FastMCP v1.26.0 changed ASGI interface — `FastMCP` object no longer callable directly; fix is `mcp_app = mcp.sse_app()` instead of `mcp_app = mcp`

KEY_LEARNINGS.md compression strategy: group individual L### entries into session blocks using one-line format preserving learning numbers for grep discoverability, achieving 64% size reduction while maintaining full recall

Graph HIHO formula: weighted avg of connectivity + reciprocity + freshness + (1-orphan_ratio); current score 0.542 (target 0.5±0.15), but appears 0.000 when using SurrealDB IN operator due to string-vs-record-link type mismatch

code.finding: New file: sync adapter mapping CAS 10 cognitive faculties to ContextPolicy TaskProfiles via Lemonade. Uses sync httpx.Client (not asyncio) to avoid event loop conflicts with sync CompoundExecutor. Filters <pad> tokens from FLM models. Collects training data on every successful classification.
Added CAS-first classification path: try CAS classifier, fall back to keyword logic if unavailable or returns None
Added lazy CAS init: CASClassifier.try_connect() at startup, passed to ContextPolicy; silent failure if Lemonade not available
FastMCP v1.26 breaking change fix: changed `mcp_app = mcp` to `mcp_app = mcp.sse_app()`. The /health endpoint still worked but all /mcp routes returned 500.

Replaced no-op stub with Lemonade-backed implementation: sync generate_narration() calls Qwen3-8B on port 13306 with /no_think prefix, async narrate() calls Kokoro TTS. Falls back gracefully if Lemonade unavailable.

New file: unified cross-store search fanning out to vault .md files (via vault MCP), SurrealDB neurons/experiments (via HTTP), and KEY_LEARNINGS.md (grep). Merges and ranks results. Query latency <10s for all three stores.
New file: session Stop hook script. Auto-persists CAS training data, new KEY_LEARNINGS entries, modified skill files, and session summary to vault+SurrealDB at session end.

New file: full multimodal pipeline. Takes JourneyTracker physics data, generates LLM narration via Qwen3-8B, TTS via Kokoro, additive sonification via numpy, matplotlib 4-panel dashboard. Total latency ~13s for 60-step journey.
Added lemonade-mcp stdio MCP server entry. Uses project venv Python. Server must be silent on stdout (no imports at module level, lazy _get_client()).
Added Stop hook pointing to scripts/session_persist.py — fires at every session end to auto-persist learnings to vault and SurrealDB
Default URL updated to port 13306 (system Lemonade with working Vulkan+CPU models). Port 13307 is vendor/embedded NPU-only instance.
Added gemma3-4b-FLM profile under lemonade_hybrid section

workflow: Lemonade `pull` via API only registers metadata — use CLI (`lemonade pull <model>`) to actually download weights, or load immediately which triggers download

Context window exhaustion (API 500 errors) is architectural, not a bug — long sessions hit it predictably. Solution: short focused sessions + compound loop to carry state between them via vault/SurrealDB
When SurrealDB IN subqueries return 0 unexpectedly, check field types with `SELECT type::is::string(field)` — type mismatch between string and record link is silent and common
FastMCP v1.26+ requires `.sse_app()` or `.streamable_http_app()` to get the ASGI handler — direct object call no longer works
ROCm on AMD Strix Halo (gfx1151) is broken for LLMs — always use Vulkan backend via `sudo -u lemonade lemonade config set llamacpp.backend=vulkan`

Prior art research before claiming novelty revealed AMD GAIA framework already has SDAgent, Whisper, Kokoro, and MCP integration — the differentiator for Cohezion is physics-grounded data, not the rendering stack

Retrospective line count targets: KEY_LEARNINGS <300 lines, MISSION_JOURNAL <150 lines, MEMORY.md <200 lines — compression by grouping individual L### entries into session blocks is the most effective technique
